    # Copy the motif in the final band into every earlier band, respecting
    # the solid separator rows/columns that partition the canvas.

    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(g[r])) == 1]

    # A separator is a full line of one color; detect lines shared as
    # background separators via repeated color and use the line colors.
    bg = g[0][0]
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if all(x == bg for x in g[r])]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(g[r][c] == bg for r in range(h))]
    row_bounds = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    # Most tasks partition in one direction; use the last non-empty band as motif.
    if len(sep_rows) >= len(sep_cols) and sep_rows:
        bands = [(a+1,b) for a,b in zip(row_bounds,row_bounds[1:]) if b>a+1]
        a,b = bands[-1]

        for lo,hi in bands[:-1]:
            for r in range(lo,hi):
                g[r] = motif[(r-lo) % len(motif)][:]

        motif = [[g[r][c] for c in range(a,b)] for r in range(h)]
        for lo,hi in bands[1:]:
            for r in range(h):
                for c in range(lo,hi):
                    g[r][c] = motif[r][(c-lo) % (b-a)]
    return g
